info.title: MAM! API
info.description:
MAM! — Discover. Review. Eat. REST API v1.

Authentication: web/admin use httpOnly cookies + X-CSRF-Token (double submit); Android uses Bearer tokens.
Google Maps content is fetched live and never stored (only Place IDs, and coordinates for ≤ 30 days).
